reviews.snippet:
This is going to be always latest feedback.

One of the worst decision I have taken selecting this hospital for my wife. What should have been one of the most important and emotional moments of my life turned into a very stressful and mentally disturbing experience because of the behaviour of certain staff members and the lack of basic patient care standards.

During the initial preparation before surgery, she observed staff handling procedures without proper gloves, which was extremely concerning from a hygiene and patient safety perspective.

Additionally, some staff members were speaking very disrespectfully in Kannada, assuming that she could not understand the language. Comments such as “today is Sunday, still so much work, why do they come and die here” were made in reference to patients. Hearing such insensitive remarks while being prepared for surgery caused me significant emotional distress.

Further, while I was in the ICU, she was provided with a pillow that had visible blood stains and appeared uncleaned.  I asked the brother to change it .This was completely unacceptable in a hospital environment where hygiene and infection control should be maintained at the highest standards.

I would also like to highlight that since my procedure was scheduled on a Sunday, I was charged an additional amount for the delivery. However, despite paying extra charges, the level of care and service provided was extremely disappointing. It raises a serious concern as to what the additional charges were for, when patients were subjected to such poor treatment and inadequate staffing.
After surgery, I had to wait for more than one hour to be shifted to the ward because housekeeping staff were unavailable, and I was informed that there was less staff due to it being a Sunday. This delay, especially after a major surgery, added further discomfort and stress during an already vulnerable time.
Overall, my pregnancy and delivery experience at the hospital was deeply disappointing. Instead of feeling cared for and supported, I felt mentally tortured, neglected, and emotionally disturbed during a time when compassion, dignity, and professionalism were expected.

We have done urine culture it shows I have severe urine infection. I am showing at other hospital and doc is zero happy about infection I have acquired in the hospital
We haven’t paid less to take all these and
Bill was more than 2 lakh
We’re we would have got better service from other hospital. Now the pain has increased to  severe level and the urine infection is not going down as almost a month.

I am giving my personal experience about this hospital . Except Doctors remaining all aspects are too worst and No proper care for babies  and mother. Below are the few points that needs to know you all .Even they wont provide water bottle for mother.

Doctors : I want to say big thank you to Dr. Krishna Shaw. From the beginning she has guided us very well and Doctor explanation was very cool and clear .No hesitation on answering our queries. Always positive and supportive to mother .

I have attached my billing detail images Please go through that and you will get a clear picture on the package. very very Miserly.

Below are the extra charges they did apart from Package Don't get shocked :
1.water bottle (Single water bottle is also chargeable , If you want water they have water filters you have to go there and bring it . No house keeping will come and give  you . If you call to them then they will tell you to go and get )

6. ID Band for mother and baby ( Even the band that they will put for mother and baby after delivery is chargeable -not included in package )
7.Tissues ( If you ask Tissues they will give just 10 tissues one time .if you call second time they wont come on same day, they will come next day only)
8.Doctor Visiting charges ( It wont include in  Package : From Day -1 including delivery day they will charge the doctor consultation charges each consultation will be 1200 per doctor ) It will only cost you extra 10,000 -(10K)
9.Alcohol swab it costs Rs . 2/-  . they have included this

ii. Reception  : They wont care about patients and babies  at billing they will take lot of time to do the billing .

vii. House Keeping : except One or two members remaining all don't have patience . Jhansi was one of the housekeeping person who did well for mother and baby.

reviews.snippet:
5/5 for NICU nurses. NICU and other nurses in the hospital are mostly on toes and appear overworked but keep pushing, I’m quite thankful.

5/5 for paediatrician Dr Shailesh and team for being hard working and counselling parents throughout NICU stay. He gave us a lot of confidence in tough times. It is because of people like him and his team we could carry on.

3/5 for housekeeping team. We were admitted thrice. Quite good experience on first two admissions, pretty delayed and lax response third time.

Minus -1/5 for poor (terrible?) management. Huge delays in receiving room after discharge of baby from NICU (5 hours), no one to attend or inform if room is ready despite informing 24 hours in advance, giving a room with decoration of wrong baby gender (?) and so on. Hospital won’t give tissues in the room no matter how many time you ask (be it for baby feeding or washroom) to speak of pettiness. Laughably even nurse station didn’t have tissues to put under sterilized items, nurses were equally irritated. So much so for hygiene and cutting costs. Would it not be better to charge for it and give so that at least patients can focus on more important things?

To store expressed milk, small fridge is only available on first floor. If you are admitted on second floor (as we were), parents or nurses have to go to first floor 10 times a day, leading to delays. How much does a small fridge even cost anyway? And very small sterilizers on nursing station which were almost full all the time, again delaying baby feed. nurses are forced to get involved in such trivial things all the time, is it not better to provide better equipment freeing them to do nursing work? Very small but important examples of poor management in the hospital leading to headache for parents in such stressful times even.

Also hospital has terrible mattresses. Might seem petty but matters a lot when you’ve a C-section and have to cry at night because of terribly deformed cots.

Care Manager (or Care-less manager) Miss Grace and team will come once a day to your room and ask feedback. Mostly nothing changes though. At baby’s discharge, she took OTP from my wife and most probably filled the feedback herself (anyway our fault). Overall you can find care team pointlessly running around with results or arguments always to management’s satisfaction. Did not inform properly about baby’s hearing test (whether it was conducted or not or when it can be conducted) and blamed the parents (even though Operations Head and consultant audiologist accepted they should have informed parents about when to do it, Ms Grace was of the disgraceful opinion that parents should inform what tests they want after NICU discharge-as if we are doctors). Vague discharge summary didn’t help either. Felt that attitude totally changed after payment of bill. Many things can be let go if attitude is empathetic/ apologetic to say the least.

Points to improve:
1. Involvement of nurses was quite low after baby’s discharge from NICU. I don’t know if that’s the case for term babies also but doctor scolded the nurses for not helping out and mother enough while in ward. Definitely can make it better. Experience before delivery was much much better.

2. Hospital gave wrong discharge summary for both mother’s delivery (later corrected by our consultant pediatrician Dr Namrata on our follow up visit to her clinic) and baby’s discharge (didn’t mention some medicines, wrong dates of admission and discharge, vague details about next test). This led to unnecessary hospital visit which could have been avoided. Junior doctors should be trained better on this, i guess, if they deem it important enough. Else it is nothing more than a pile of doubtful information.

reviews.snippet:
Avoid maternity hospitals and particularly this Apollo Cradle

My wife delivered a baby in Feb'24. Normal delivery and great first day but from Day 2 things started going south. Baby was drowsy (all babies are), refusing feeds, elevated breathing and didn't cry when pricked for a glucose test.

Despite highlighting all these the paediatric who came on rounds said everything is normal. We also highlighted that during the bath earlier his hands/legs were shaking a bit strangely. Ended up saying I am a senior paediatric and trust me.<1st problem>

In a few hours we were in the NICU where baby ended up having GTC seizures. Several blood samples were drawn for further evaluation. Unfortunately these maternity hospitals don't have inhouse labs for all kinds of tests. Simple blood test reports came in timely which were thankfully normal but some samples were sent out to other labs which took more than 10 hours. <2nd Problem>

Day 3 of life our child is on oxygen support and having medications for seizures and bunch of other things. NICU docs have some idea of what it could be but instead of treating for that, it felt as if they were underconfident and leaning towards making us think about stopping the treatment for the baby. I appreciate them highlighting what we probably could be signing up for in terms of quality of life for baby and family but instead of focusing on that, would have really appreciated if the treatment would have been started. We realised later that our baby needed dialysis immediately and they don't have inhouse docs/specialists for that. Not sure if they even had all the equipment. (#1 reason why you should go to a multi-speciality hospital even for maternity. You never know what's needed). Even the EEG took more than 8-10 hours after it was planned as a doc from outside the hospital had to come and do it.

We started reaching out to our friends and family to understand which is the best NICU team in Blr and were recommended Manipal NICU. We are not originally from Bangalore and hence chose Apollo because it was near to our home. Maybe we were over confident because this was our second baby. For our first kid I was adamant on a multi-speciality and everything went smoothly which made us believe that maybe just maternity is not that bad a choice.

We reached out to senior team of Manipal and they were happy to get on a call with the NICU team at Apollo Cradle and made some suggestions on the treatment including taking the baby on ventilator immediately.

Our baby is suffering from a metabolical disorder (UCD) which needed immediate attention by super specialists and it became increasingly clear that we won't get that at Apollo Cradle. Ultimately we moved from Apollo Cradle to Manipal Old Airport Road. If the Apollo team would have suggested we move to another hospital themself, we could have saved a few crucial hours which means less neuro damage for the baby. Still grateful to the team at Apollo Cradle for keeping my baby alive till transfer. I am grateful to the Manipal team for showing confidence given the delicate situation and accepting us.

My other problem with Apollo is additional charges that they added to our bill. Given the urgency, I paid the entire bill immediately as we had to transfer. Later on after multiple visits they refunded some charges but not all. One additional charge - 10,000 for Doctor consultation for my wife shouldn't be there as it was part of maternity package. May be they realised that our insurance probably allowed higher claim for maternity and thus added a few extras. <Third Problem>

Lastly the overall relative hygiene of the place. It is not too bad and most people will accept this as good in India. So did we but honestly after recalling our experience at Fortis Jaipur for the first kid and Manipal hospital later, this Apollo needs an upgrade.

In case you are curious, the baby spent about 25 days in hospital and is now at home. He continues to be on special diet/medication and will have to go through a liver transplant soon.

reviews.snippet:
Hospital is clean & well maintained with good ambiance! Staffs are very cooperative and supportive!

But we had very worst experience while we were in the consultation last week! Some one was shouting on top of her voice in the waiting area near reception the voice was such loud that we were unable to hear what our treating Dr was speaking inside consultation room! In fact she had to repeat couple of time and literally stopped talking for 5-10min in the middle of consultation assuming some patient attendant is creating ruckus! But later when we came out my sister said who was siting in waiting area and observed it live said it was one devil lady by name called Dr Poornima Ramakrishna who was shouting on top of her voice just becoz some other doctor parked their vehicle in her so-called reserved parking! reviews.snippet:
I had my baby delivered here at Apollo cradle koramangala. I would like to share my personal experience about this hospital on whole.  There's so much to tell about them that I'm leaving 2 reviews. Please do read them for a better understanding of the hospital.

REVIEW 1
Doctors: I was referred to Dr. Prajwal Hegde from alot of people and friends and family. With all honesty she is the best doctor anyone could ever ask for. I have consulted a few doctors but nobody to compare with her. She is genuine, gives ample amount of time to her patients, is always available anytime of the day  and builds a personal relationship. But apart from being sweet and experienced the one thing that tops it all is that she made me go through normal delivery! I had no hope for normal. But she motivated me and was stern that she'd do normal delivery for me. Along with Dr. Prajwal, Dr. Seema was amazing. During my labour Dr. Seema assisted me the whole time, built confidence when I had absolutely given up on normal delivery and wanted to go for c section. Dr. Seema kept me going through out my labour and was extremely sweet and made sure I don't give up during the long hours of my labour. Her duty was over but still she stayed with me all day and night while I was in labour. Excellent doctor.!
They both make an amazing team. And would recommend everyone to go to them.!!
Staff : the housekeeping (helper aunties) were really nice and sweet. Cannot complain about them.. Gayatri ,Shakuntala, Kavita. Jhansi really helped me in and out of the washroom and with the sitz bath.
But not all staff was good. The night maintenance guy was rude, lazy and also didn't know his job. Mr. Hemanth couldnt solve our issues or assist us. When the ac didn't work he argued with us saying that the weather is so cold why do we need ac. Apart from Mr. Hemanth the worst of the worst experience that i had was with the photographer.. The team that came for the photoshoot was horrible. First of all they didmt come to take the pictures and made us wait 5 hours after our discharge time when they came their attitude was soo bad and the man was rude, didn't corporate and told us that we need to select the photos fast since he doesn't have time to waste and we were wasting his time with questions. The man also seemed like he hadn't slept for days and was very unprofessional. Unfortunately I didn't get his name but I did raise a complain with the reception during checkout. My relative had delivered in the month of March '20 and the photographer then was brilliant. But this guy was pathetic!

reviews.snippet:
This is a continuation of Previous review from Nada Mir

Review part 2
Hospital: let me be very frank with everyone reading this review. Please do not go to this hospital for your delivery! Since your doctor can come to any hospital you want to get delivered in. There's is nothing good about this hospital premises. LOBBY - over crowded. Cannot handle the patients and not at all hygienic.  PARKING - the hospital does not have any parking. To top it off it's in a residential area so you don't have parking till a distance. SECURITY - pathetic security, especially the evening ones were I'll mannered. Rude. Do not know how to behave with pregnant woman. Also dint let us park for ten minutes while I was getting off the car and was in pain.  CANTEEN - the canteen is hopeless. They don't even have a microwave. Its a maternity hospital which does not have a microwave. Horrible service and they didn't have milk or bread at night. So if you get hungry and are dealing with postpartum then please use swiggy or Zomato since this hospital can't provide you with basic food at night. Whereas they say that the canteen is open 24/7. Other than water they can't offer you anything.  LABOUR ROOM - the labour room was nothing like a labour room. The room had filing cabinet which they kept opening and closing. The doors made loud noise everytime anyone opened it, even the corridor door was soo loud that I could hear it in the labour room. There was no privacy, nurses kept coming in and talking loudly and having conversations with each other while I was on epidural and wanted to rest for a bit. The washroom in the labour room was dingy and dirty. There were mops and wipers kept right next to the toilet seat and were touching me when I went to use it. It was pathetic. The room was messy and dirty.  ROOMS - what do I say about the rooms.. The curtains were dirty. The ac didn't work at all times. For that matter, none of the rooms had working AC. The hospital didn't have enough bedsheets to change them daily. NURSE STATION - they are under staffed at night.! The nurse station half the time Is empty. When you require assistance they don't come. We had to go hunting for them on each floor to call them at night.
The only good thing about this hospital other than the doctor was the manager, Mrs. Manjula. She knew all our complains were legit and tried to do the best for us. But even with all her help and assistance it was pathetic since the very infrastructure of Appolo cradle is bad. Still she managed everything very well. Was available on call24/7. She's a sweet lady and only because of her is this hospital being managed even with all ​the customer complains.
Overall experience needless to say was really bad. And funnily enough I knew all  tthe ncons sbout this hospital but had to opt tforr it  because was really close to my house and Dr. Hegde comes here.
Otherwise I'd had  chosen  cloud 9 since pricing is similar to apollo cradle bbut  so much bbetter in every way. Cleanliness and more professional.
